hero.title: Physiotherapy in Mauritius
hero.subtitle: **Physiotherapy in Mauritius for Indian Students** is a healthcare study pathway for students interested in rehabilitation, movement science, injury recovery and improving patients’ mobility and quality of life. The country has a university-based physiotherapy programme historically documented by the University of Mauritius, alongside training in physiotherapy assistance. Students planning to **Study Physiotherapy in Mauritius** should understand the available qualifications and their professional outcomes.

overview: The Allied Health Professionals Council (AHPC) of Mauritius regulates physiotherapists and publishes professional registration requirements. Before applying, students should confirm the current course intake, fees, clinical placement arrangements and recognition of the qualification. **Edu-Hawk Worldwide** encourages students to verify these details before selecting a programme.

faq.question: Can Indian students study physiotherapy in Mauritius?
faq.answer: Indian students can explore eligible programmes, but must confirm international admission eligibility, current intake availability and recognition of the exact qualification. Edu-Hawk Worldwide can help students understand the admission considerations for Physiotherapy in Mauritius for Indian Students.

faq.question: How many years does it take to study physiotherapy in Mauritius?
faq.answer: The University of Mauritius has published a four-year, full-time BSc (Hons) Physiotherapy programme structure. Confirm whether the programme is currently admitting students and whether its duration or structure has changed.

faq.question: What is the cost of studying physiotherapy in Mauritius?
faq.answer: The total cost depends on the institution, programme and student status. Request official tuition fees, accommodation costs and clinical-training charges before making a financial decision.

faq.question: Can I work as a physiotherapist in Mauritius after graduation?
faq.answer: You must satisfy the applicable professional registration requirements. The Allied Health Professionals Council regulates physiotherapists and publishes the relevant professional regulations.

faq.question: Is a physiotherapy degree from Mauritius recognised in India?
faq.answer: Recognition is not automatic. Before enrolling, check the current requirements with the relevant Indian authorities and professional bodies for foreign physiotherapy qualifications and registration. Confirm the status of the exact institution and programme rather than relying on general claims about international recognition.
